text_block_list.text:
Something changes for Rice Shower<n>after the
Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: H-hey! You're Rice!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Eep! Y-yes, I am!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Don't be nervous! We just want to<n>say you were
amazing at the Kikuka<n>Sho the other day!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
That's right! I got goosebumps<n>watching you race
against Bourbon!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Me too! And she was soooo cool!<n>Her face was so
intense!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Yes! Bourbon is super fast... And<n>really cool!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
That's why you can't give up, Rice!<n>We'll be
cheering for you!
R-really?! Thanks!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: B-Big Brother?!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: B-Big Sister?!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I-it's not like that... They just wanted<n>to talk to me
about Bourbon.

Everyone in the crowd at the Kikuka<n>Sho was
cheering for her, so—
choice_data_list:
They were also cheering because her rival was
there—you.

They were also cheering because her rival was
there—you.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Agh... D-don't flatter me that much...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Agh... D-don't flatter me that much...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...But her rival, huh? Hehehe...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
However, we get a glimpse of the<n>other side of the
coin the next day.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Whisper, whisper...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Stay back!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: It looks like it's getting to her.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Yeah, it would get to me too.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Just look what happened to<n>Bourbon—she's
always in perfect<n>form, but right after racing with
Rice<n>Shower... Well, you know.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Sob... Wh-why... why does thisalways happen?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Why do I always bring misfortune to<n>the people
around me? Why do I<n>always cause trouble?!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Big Brother?!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Big Sister?!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Stay back! You'll just get hurt if you<n>come close to
me!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...No matter how hard she trained,<n>Bourbon has
never been injured...<n>Until...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
It's all my fault... It happened<n>because she became
rivals with me...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
The first three years of an<n>Umamusume's career
are<n>life-changing… and I've ruined it for<n>her during
the most important time.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...She doesn't have to. After all, I—
choice_data_list: So you haven't asked her about it.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Wait!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Wait!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
choice_data_list: Sorry for showing up all of a sudden.
Sorry for showing up all of a sudden.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
It is no problem. I have become<n>accustomed to
having visitors wish<n>me well recently.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Now, please state your objective.
I... I want to apologize. I'm sorry... I'm<n>so sorry!

It's... my fault that you got hurt! I've<n>ruined this
important time for you!
Pardon me, but...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Why are you apologizing? My data<n>indicates you
have nothing to do with<n>the cause of my injury.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
B-but... you'd never been injured<n>until you became
my rival!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Your reasoning is insufficient. My<n>probability of
injury has remained<n>consistent. Conclusion—your
theory is<n>virtually groundless.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
If you insist that you possess the<n>ability to summon
misfortune, then I<n>shall test the hypothesis using
myself<n>as subject.
...You want to test it on yourself?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Correct. I have acknowledged you as<n>my rival.

I sensed your potential for growth at<n>the Kikuka
Sho. I have counted on it.

I predicted that if you were to become<n>my rival, I
would also grow even<n>stronger.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I also predicted the possibility of a<n>so-called
miracle—that you and I might<n>one day run the
ultimate race.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
If my poor luck has anything to do<n>with you, Rice,
then surely that race<n>will never occur.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Will you bring me misfortune? Or will<n>you perform a
miracle with me?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: That's...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower is unable to answer,<n>Bourbon's words
shaking her to her<n>very core.
